Smoke test: XLSX with basic spreadsheet data including tables

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet","uri":"https://example.com/xlsx/stanley_cups.xlsx"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].mime_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].content);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].tables);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].metadata.format.as_ref().unwrap().excel().as_ref().unwrap().sheet_count);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].metadata.format.as_ref().unwrap().excel().as_ref().unwrap().sheet_names);
}
```
